title: Bruce Erickson's theory that Ransone was a spy
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Bruce Erickson's theory that Ransone was a spy, about 1970s at an unknown place, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: On Jesse Michels' podcast, an unnamed researcher talked about a story of a CIA scientist said to have contacted an alien council in the 1970s. The researcher says another man, Bruce Erickson, speculates that a woman in the story, Valerie Ransone, was some kind of spy. If true, it would change how the whole contact story should be read.
